name: Mandalorian training darts
description: Mandalorian training darts were a harmless weapon used for training. During the New Republic Era, the Mandalorian foundlings Ragnar and Grogu used the training darts to duel each other. The dart splattered when it hit a target. Later, Grogu, accompanied by several Anzellans in a sewer tunnel, shot an aggressive rat-like creature in its one eye, scaring it off and prompting praise from one of the youngling's diminutive companions.
